archetypes.name: dyn-repair-loop-contract
archetypes.rationale: Changed NEXT_ACTION and ledger behavior for a narrow repair-loop status/site combination.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the repair-loop CLI envelope when LOOP_STATUS is no-changes-stale. Confirm only the intended sites route to main-agent-edit, the ledger fields are complete and sourced from a validated checks log, and ship-pr CI sites still stall. Pay special attention to stdout keys consumed by orchestrator scripts. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
